cands.bio: Republican elected to the Alabama House of Representatives for District 17 in November 2026, unopposed in the general election. He ran for the same seat in 2018 and lost the Republican primary runoff to Tracy Estes. Career and background details were not found in the sources available.
cands.gaps: We couldn't find where Phil Segraves was born or raised, when he came to Alabama, or his occupation and work history. We found no stated positions on data centers, property taxes, land ownership, development, immigration, campaign money, policing, guns, abortion or education. Ballotpedia says he did not complete its 2026 candidate survey and lists no endorsements. We found no documented controversies or foreign ties. The Wikipedia page is a one-line stub with no further detail.
